visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands with manicured white nails and gold jewelry unboxes a white package. The box features the text 'RADIATE, FROM WITHIN.' and branding for 'NAGUMO MIYUKI x TYMO'. Inside, a striped garment in a plastic bag is revealed against a neutral wood-patterned floor. (2) A woman with short brown hair stands in an indoor room with white louvered closet doors and a white sofa. She holds up a yellow and black striped long-sleeve shirt to show its design. (3) A close-up shot shows a black electric hair straightener brush with purple bristles. The woman's thumb presses a button on the handle. She then uses the brush to comb through her hair in a mirror, demonstrating the straightening effect on her brown, chin-length hair. (4) The woman is now wearing the off-the-shoulder striped shirt. She poses for the camera, touching her hair to show its smoothness and shine. In the final seconds, she puts on black cat-eye sunglasses and smiles, transitioning to a confident outdoor-ready look.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic beat begins. A female narrator speaks with an enthusiastic, bright tone in Mandarin. Faint rustling of cardboard and plastic is heard as the box is opened. (2) The BGM continues with a driving synth melody. The narrator's speech rate is fast and bubbly, describing the clothing item. Short whoosh sound effects emphasize the scene transition. (3) A soft mechanical 'click' is heard as the device is activated. The narrator explains the simplicity of the hair tool. The BGM remains consistent in the background, providing a upbeat atmosphere. (4) The narration concludes with a playful, friendly sign-off. The music swells slightly at the end before fading out. The overall acoustic environment is clean and post-produced.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional unboxing and tutorial for a limited edition collaboration gift box between NAGUMO MIYUKI and TYMO. It aims to showcase the contents—a striped shirt and a hair straightening brush—and demonstrate the tool's effectiveness in transforming messy hair into a smooth, stylish look, encouraging viewers to purchase the 7th-anniversary set.
